sentences.text: Bealbonn is an extinct genus of holocephalians, a group within the class Chondrichthyes that includes modern sharks and rays.
This genus contains only one known species, Bealbonn rogaire, and is classified within the family Gregoriidae.
Fossils of Bealbonn are found in the Bear Gulch Limestone lagerstätte in Montana, United States.
These animals lived between 326.9 and 323.6 million years ago during the Serpukhovian age.
